image_description: A night-time urban street scene featuring a traffic signal pole in the foreground. The pole supports a vertical traffic light unit with an illuminated red circular lens at the top and an illuminated green pedestrian 'walk' symbol below it. In the background, there is a building facade with large windows and signage reading 'SNRIS' (likely 'PARIS' distorted) and a diamond-shaped street sign with illegible text.

artifact_observations.location: Background building signage ('SNRIS') and diamond street sign
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the building facade is nonsensical ('SNRIS' instead of PARIS or similar), and the text on the diamond sign is illegible scribbles. This is a classic AI generation artifact where text structures are mimicked but not rendered correctly.

The traffic light combines a vehicle signal (red) and a pedestrian signal (green walking man) in a single vertical housing without proper separation or standard sequencing (missing amber). This represents a functional/structural logic failure common in AI generations.
The reflections in the windows are smeared and lack sharp geometric definition, blending into the wall texture rather than reflecting distinct environmental features.
